facts.fact_text: The case concerns police ill-treatment of the applicants during a political rally on 6 May 2012 at Bolotnaya Square.
The applicants were neither convicted of mass disorder nor accused of any other offence in connection with the relevant events at Bolotnaya Square.
Both applicants participated in the political rally on 6 May 2012.
